preservation_constraints.requirement: Keep frozen technical baseline `clean_boot` passing. Do not treat this as a mandate to preserve the same visible asset, map, HUD family, or material choice if a higher-quality replacement is available and the PRD still fits.

task_specification.objective: Deliver a clean-booting combat-readability slice in which ordinary deployment reaches Alpha before Bravo, all 18 enemies retain distributed autonomous combat with rifle-correct visible motion, and the complete shell/HUD remains navigable and unobstructed at 1280×720 and persisted 200% UI scale for keyboard/mouse and gamepad.

diagnosis.root_cause: The candidate has three coupled authority defects. M4 actors explicitly map idle, aim, fire, and reload to pistol clips, so AI state can be correct while presentation is semantically false. The 3/5/10 encounter proof is then blocked because deployment guidance and roster readiness are not gated by a fresh native-navigation route that ends in legal Alpha overlap. Separately, shell pages, gameplay guidance, world objective notices, and the scaled HUD do not share one post-layout visibility/safe-area authority, allowing an opaque route surface or the Bravo-locked notice to contradict telemetry at 200% scale. The bound visual evidence for the opaque card is weak, but the active issue and source ownership still justify an isolation repair and focused recapture.

stop_conditions: Stop if clean boot, candidate resource loading, or the preserved no-error baseline regresses.
Stop rather than alter, extract, duplicate, or reposition authored map children if legal Alpha reachability cannot be restored through candidate-owned anchors, navigation, collision, and bindings.
Stop and retain the animation issue if the bound libraries contain no validated rifle-compatible required clips; do not substitute pistol clips or frozen poses.
Stop and retain the UI issue if post-layout pixel bounds or matched gameplay frames contradict safe-area telemetry at 200% scale.
Do not claim progression or lifecycle closure from source or telemetry alone; Tester must retain fresh continuous runtime, visual, and input-family evidence.
Do not pull deferred bomb-finale, atmosphere, performance, general feedback, or decorative world work into this iteration.

This avoids another round of transform/timing tuning while preserving the intact authored map, accepted collision, typography, video transition, weapon behavior, and restart controls.
